preselection_gate.general_rule: both counts must be strictly greater than target_per_domain
preselection_gate.existing_80_case_panels_are: regression and audit inputs, not sufficient candidate pools

population: named bounded approved executable subset; no automatic broad-pool expansion
quality_required: accepted with per-equation support and domain-validity receipt

unary_strata.ties: equal unary counts stay together; equality belongs to lower bin
unary_strata.empty_or_repeated_bins: collapse; retain at most five nonempty strata
unary_strata.edge_Q75: inverse empirical CDF within unary stratum
unary_strata.edge_median: middle value or average of two middle values

unary_histogram_targets: N*n_k/C over accepted multidimensional unique classes; no independent rounding
tie_break: lexicographically smallest sorted SHA256 list of UTF-8 421|domain|source_model_id|equation_id
infeasible_action: do not select without a usable surplus; report capacity and request a named source extension or smaller common N with a surplus
